fieldNotes.truckGate: Aug-2025 Street View from 42nd Street S shows the entrance driveway and the entire west-face dock apron open directly to the public road. A chain-link perimeter fence exists between Pactiv and the neighbor to the north, but there is NO barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point lane control across either the visitor driveway or the truck apron. The corner monument sign reading 'pactiv evergreen' positively confirms the facility.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere at the entrance. The only protruding structure on the dock face is a dock office/penthouse flush against the building, not a free-standing 1-3-space guard booth beside a gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - there is no truck gate at all, so no remote check-in apparatus is implied.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Two dock banks on the west face: a north bank (~6 doors with box trucks/trailers backed in, seen in the NW Street View) and a longer west/southwest bank (~10 doors visible in z20 satellite). Total estimated ~16 - flagged as a band estimate from trailer spacing.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A row of ~8-10 trailers parked without tractors along the paved strip on the west edge of the lot, between the building and 42nd Street - a genuine trailer drop/storage area.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The west dock apron is deep (~40 m) and the lot is large; a 3+ truck queue stages entirely on-property off the public road.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the building's faces are paved apron or grass only.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park on the south side of Moorhead MN, bordered by open farmland to the east and south - judged Rural per the small-town rule.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~8.7 acres covers the single building, west dock apron, drop strip and employee parking.
